reviews.title: Where have all the songs gone?
reviews.text: I was loving this app. It was working really well for me and so I paid for a yearly subscription and then almost immediately loads of songs, loads of major songs are missing from the app. I’ve looked on Reddit it seems to be suggested that they’ve not paid for the licenses for those songs but this is pretty poor form and I assume this app is going out of business if it can’t fix what should be a pretty simple isse to resolve.  Secondly, looked at a lot of guitar tabs over the years and I don’t know how, what we all used to share for free amongst each other on various apps, has become locked behind a paywall. At least in the past you could just go buy the tab book and then you owned it. The digital age is actually not really beneficial long-term is it?

reviews.title: Annoying When You Just Want a Tuner

The tuner doesn’t work offline either - don’t see why something so simple needs to be online and tired of constantly having to update the whole app when I just want the tuner aspect.

reviews.title: Ridiculously bad as a tuner
reviews.text: Takes ages to load, needs an internet connection and constantly tries to sell you things. Trying to make money off a guitar tuner app is a bold effort and these folks are going all in. The tuning interface is fancy but who needs a fancy tuning interface? Much prefer a tuner that loads, doesn’t need the internet to be on all the time (tried and it just stalled) and doesn’t keep trying to sell you upgrades and songs to learn. Might be fun as a song learning tool but as a tuner it’s almost silly how bad it is.

reviews.title: TAKES TOO LONG TO LOAD
reviews.text: Hi, I’ve used your app for a long time. The tuner functions wonderfully. And looks great. But my massive complaint with it is IT’s JUST A SIMPLE TUNER! It’s critical as a musician and music teacher that I need to be able to reliably pull my phone out in a pinch and know that I can tune quickly and get back to teaching or playing. It upsets me to know and when I click on that and sometimes it will just sit there and load for like up to 45 seconds. In truth it might only be like 25 or 30 seconds. But it is still infuriating. I really prefer the function and display of your app more than other tuning apps but the loading time is just so annoying! I feel like your app is just too bloated, nobody wants to play along to Green Day after they tune they just want a tuner. And also I totally understand this one but I wish you could make your paywall elsewhere or not have to scroll through it. That one’s fair I don’t really mind it but yeah the initial loading time is in my opinion just unacceptable.
